# HexPiece 3.1.2

Your notes on the Gura fruit. Not tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and every change was rendered and checked.

- **Tsunami, as in the show.** Both arms smashed out to the sides, then two walls of water rise slowly on your left and right
  (about 1 second) and roll in toward the middle ahead of you, carrying whoever they hit, then crash together and slam everyone
  caught down. **It only works near a big body of water** (a sea or a lake within about 24 blocks). Without one you get a message
  and no cooldown. The waves sit on the water's surface.
- **The glass crack is slower, smaller and slimmer.** The cracks now run out one by one in little jumps over about half a second,
  hair-thin white lines with a faint cyan edge, side cracks branching off, like real glass giving way. They hold, then shatter.
- **No more legs in the Gura animations.** Every Gura move now animates only the arms and the upper body (turn and bend at the
  waist), never the legs or the whole body's position.
- **Sneaking + a move no longer breaks the body.** Using a Gura or Light fruit move while sneaking drops the sneak pose for the
  move, so the torso isn't pushed forward any more (you still sneak).
- **Kabutowari jumps much higher** (about 8 blocks plus more the further you go), always comes down on solid ground (looking up
  now leaps straight up and slams down where you stand; over nothing solid it won't fire), and the cracks, crater and quake only
  happen once you touch down. No more cracks in the sky and no flying with it.
- **Conqueror's Haki mixed in (Blackbeard).** With Haki Ryou on (and the Conqueror's Haki unlocked), every Gura move adds the
  Conqueror's black lightning in your Ryou colour: crackling round the charging fist, bursting out of every crack and impact, the
  quake punches, the slam, the rift, the island shake and the landing quake.
